result.notes: Measure failed: the SJC barred it from the November 2026 ballot, so coverage describes the proposed scope only. The petition text is not in the corpus. The SJC opinion (DX03) confirms only the educational/religious/nonprofit facilities exemption. The owner-occupied (four or fewer units), 10-year new-construction, publicly regulated and short-term rental exemptions rest on the secondary blog DX14. Changes from the input: requires_unknown_facts is set to false, because the measure covers ordinary rental units and its exemptions are listed instead. Short-term rentals are added to unverifiable_exemptions. 'Per DX14' annotations are removed from the values. The new-construction limit is a rolling age (less than 10 years old) rather than a fixed date, so construction_cutoff stays null; its basis (year built vs. occupancy) is unspecified. The petition would have repealed G.L. c. 40P, but supersedes_state_rule and may_preempt_local_rules are left null as not applicable or unsupported.
